set.body: Implement bounded pointwise sign-flip inference for independent symmetric subject contrast errors with common center, prespecified selection and sign-invariant precisions. Native ScalaFIM owns the scientific contract; reuse Multivar row sign actions. Exact and identity-corrected Monte Carlo paths, subject-bound reusable actions, no nuisance/repeated-measure admission, independent exhaustive oracle, held-out null/power and confidence-set coverage, JVM/JS and resource evidence. Parent admission ticket remains open for covariate-adjusted alternatives and broader defaults.
set.title: Qualify one-sample group symmetry inference with exact and Monte Carlo tests
